paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: Illustrating the empirical generalization errors and sharpness measures with respect to QLoRA weights. (<ref>) Smaller adapters with a rank of 16 achieve the lowest generalization errors. Additionally, the Hessian trace values correlate with generalization errors, suggesting that smaller adapters tend to converge to flatter minima. (<ref>) An ensemble of k adapters leads to lower generalization errors and Hessian traces. Here, we fix the sum of the dimensions of k adapters to be equal to 256. (<ref>) QLoRA, which is trained on a quantized base model, yields lower generalization errors and Hessian trace values compared to LoRA.

annotations.annotation: Die Abbildung ist ein Liniendiagramm und veranschaulicht die Fehler, die mit verschiedenen Werten von \ k \ im Kontext von COPA verbunden sind. Die horizontale Achse ist beschriftet mit "k" und verwendet eine lineare Skala von 1 bis 8 mit Teilstrichen bei 1, 2, 4 und 8. Die vertikale Achse verwendet eine lineare Skala mit einem Bereich von 0.0 bis 0.9 und Teilstrichen im Abstand von 0.3. Das Diagramm besteht aus einer Linie. Diese ist schwarz mit grünen kreisförmigen Markierungen und hat bei 1 einen Wert von ungefähr 0.65, bei 2 einen Wert von 0.3, bei 4 einen Wert von 0.25 und bei 8 einen Wert von 0.2.

The plot illustrates the errors associated with different values of k in the context of the COPA task. The x-axis is labeled k and uses an exponential scale ranging from 1 to 8, with tick labels at 1,2,4, and 8. The y-axis is labeled with errors and is also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.9, with tick marks at intervals of 0.3. The plot features a single line that is black and solid, with circular markers that are green in color. This line shows a decreasing trend across the x-axis. At k = 1 , the error value is approximately 0.7. The line declines sharply to about 0.3 at k = 2 . It continues to decrease, reaching around 0.25 at k = 4 , and then slowly decreases to approximately 0.2 at k = 8 . Error bars are present at each data point to indicate variability, with roughly equal variability for each of the markers.

Линейната графика илюстрира грешките, свързани с различни стойности на (k ) в контекста на COPA. Оста x е обозначена с (k ) и използва експоненциална скала, варираща от 1 до 8, с отметки на 1, 2, 4 и 8 единици, въпреки че някои стойности като 3, 5, 6 и 7 нямат отметки. Оста y е обозначена с грешки и е в линейна скала, варираща от 0.0 до 0.9, с отметки на интервали от 0.3. Графиката включва една линия, която е черна и плътна, с кръгли маркери, които са зелени на цвят. Тази линия показва намаляваща тенденция по оста x. При (k = 1 ) стойността на грешката е приблизително 0.65. Линията рязко намалява до около 0.3 при (k = 2 ). Тя продължава да намалява, достигайки около 0.25 при (k = 4 ), и след това бавно намалява до приблизително 0.2 при (k = 8 ). Във всяка точка от данните има ленти за грешки.
